reason: The 0.5 m prototype checkpoint journal repeatedly rewrote every dirty voxel. By frame 4009 it caused sustained processing lag and excessive checkpoint growth, so the run was stopped before the full bag completed.
corrective_action: Use a 1.0 m independent lifecycle voxel and checkpoint only newly created voxels once per interval; keep the frame stream flushed periodically and write all current voxel statistics only during graceful finalization.
